# Paul K. Lunow - Personal Website (Full Content)

> Complete content of https://www.paul-lunow.de/ in Markdown, English version.
> Paul K. Lunow: CTO at Vention, author of the cyber novel Riaru, Certified Claude Architect, podcast host and mentor.

## Welcome

Hi, I'm Paul. And you've landed on my personal website.

**As a child, I dreamed of becoming a writer.** This desire inspired me to program a literature portal - a place where my friends and I could share our ideas and thoughts during school time. This dream became a journey: 20 years in the tech industry, in which I worked in almost every conceivable role around technology. Now my childhood dream has come true: In January 2025, my first novel, Riaru, was published.

**Today I live at the intersection of technology, leadership and creativity.** As CTO at Vention and Certified Claude Architect, I help companies implement successful technology and AI projects. In my podcast, I share my knowledge about tech products and leadership. I also accompany teams and companies as a mentor and consultant to find orientation in the digital world.

This website reflects all facets of my work and passion. Whether you want to order my book, are looking for inspiring podcast episodes, or are looking for a sparring partner for your digital challenges - I look forward to your message and your feedback.

Let's get in touch! Follow me on LinkedIn or Instagram, or write me a message - I look forward to hearing from you.

## Podcast - Product & Cake

Product&Cake Podcast is the perfect companion in the wild Product-Tech world.

Ghonche and I met at mobile.de in the podcast studio. No one needed the studio at the time and we had cake with us, so we recorded a podcast for fun. The feedback in the internal chat was overwhelming. Just like the fun we had during the recording. So we kept going!

At Vention, I get to support companies as CTO in implementing successful technology projects. With the expertise of over 3000 developers, we can lead any project to success.

## Consulting and Mentoring

Bring me into your team! I help find ways in the vast sea of possibilities.

As a founder of several companies, team leader and strategy consultant, I have gained comprehensive experience in recent years: from building and leading motivated teams to successfully pitching ideas to implementing scalable solutions. Today I pass on this knowledge - to people, teams and companies that are looking for orientation, want to overcome challenges or achieve their goals faster.

What I bring:

- **Experience** - Well-founded insights into founding, growth and leadership - combined with practical solutions.
- **Clarity** - I help you make quick decisions and recognize wrong paths early.
- **Perspective** - Fresh impulses that help you see complex challenges from a new perspective.

What I do:

- **Start-ups** - As a sparring partner, coach and listener, I get to accompany some founders in the most exciting phase of their lives.
- **Mentoring** - As a mentor at Tech4Germany, I support young talents in making our government more digital!
- **Advisory Board** - An outside perspective is important for every company. As a member of the advisory board, I contribute my experience.

It always excites me to support people and companies in getting the best out of themselves - motivated, efficient and with a clear focus on the future. Following my motto: "The answer to how is yes!"

## Book - Riaru

Your look behind the scenes. Riaru is the debut novel by Paul K. Lunow and provides insight into the world of tech companies.

### Welcome to the most modern company in the world

Riaru is the most globally successful company: an online multiplayer game that allows its users to dive into foreign worlds, realize themselves and even profitably market their own business. Making the world a better place for everyone is Riaru's declared goal.

Mic desperately wants to contribute to this idealistic idea. But even an excellent degree in software development is meaningless when acquired in a small Argentine town. The career leap to Europe seems hopeless. But then Tuuli, the founder of Riaru, notices Mic. The job at the Berlin headquarters is like a dream. Until Mic wakes up.

Paul K. Lunow, himself a founder and programmer, provides deep insights into the structure of tech corporations and the handling of metadata in this exciting cyber novel. With his extensive background knowledge, he makes us understand what complex digital processes happen in the systems behind our monitors.

### Facts

- Pages: 244
- Language: German
- Publisher: Periplaneta (https://www.periplaneta.com/)
- Release date: January 15, 2025
